description: This file contains the `CatalogContextSeed` class responsible for seeding initial data into the catalog database context, including preconfigured brands, types, and items, with retry logic for database availability.

classes.name: CatalogContextSeed
classes.description: Provides static methods for seeding initial catalog data into the database context, including retry logic.

methods.name: SeedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously seeds the catalog database with predefined brands, types, and items if they do not already exist, with retry for database availability.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredCatalogBrands
methods.description: Returns an enumerable list of predefined `CatalogBrand` instances for initial data seeding.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredCatalogTypes
methods.description: Returns an enumerable list of predefined `CatalogType` instances for initial data seeding.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredItems
methods.description: Returns an enumerable list of predefined `CatalogItem` instances, representing sample catalog data.
